options.name: check_command
options.description: The command used to check if the host is alive.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, O(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If O(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The name used to display the host. If not specified, it defaults to the value of the O(name) parameter.

options.name: force
options.description: If V(yes) do not get a cached copy.

options.name: force_basic_auth
options.description: C(httplib2), the library used by Ansible's HTTP request code only sends authentication information when a webservice responds to an initial request with a 401 status. Since some basic auth services do not properly send a 401, logins may fail. This option forces the sending of the Basic authentication header upon initial request.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP address of the host. This is no longer required since community.general 8.0.0.

options.name: name
options.description: Name used to create / delete the host. This does not need to be the FQDN, but does needs to be unique.

options.name: template
options.description: The template used to define the host. Template cannot be modified after object creation.

options.name: url
options.description: HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP URL in the form V((http|https|ftp\)://[user[:pass]]@host.domain[:port]/path).

options.name: url_password
options.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication. If the O(url_username) parameter is not specified, the O(url_password) parameter is not used.

options.name: url_username
options.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication. This parameter can be used without O(url_password) for sites that allow empty passwords.

options.name: use_gssapi
options.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library L(gssapi,https://github.com/pythongssapi/python-gssapi) to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with O(url_username)/O(url_password) or with the GSSAPI env var E(KRB5CCNAME) that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is B(not) supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If V(false), it does not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zone
options.description: The zone from where this host should be polled.
